nodes.name: service.rs
nodes.summary: GatewayService owns channel lifecycle (start/stop/toggle) and spawns the inbound/outbound background workers that shuttle messages between channels and OS agent sessions.

nodes.name: workers.rs
nodes.summary: Background tokio tasks that drain the inbound message-merge buffer to the session handler and dispatch outbound messages back through the ChannelManager.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Layer 2b module root aggregating chat-channel connectors, the decoupled message gateway, rule-based automation, and integrations config/patch.

nodes.name: patch.rs
nodes.summary: Typed IntegrationsConfigPatch with Option<T> fields for replace-per-field updates to channels, databases, nodes, web_search, mcp, embedding, and excluded skills.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: agent-core crate root documenting the 4-layer architecture (foundation -> core -> intelligence/integrations -> state) and re-exporting the public module surface.

nodes.name: lifecycle.rs
nodes.summary: Shared post-turn lifecycle helpers for agent sessions: emits session status/rename/account-switch events, persists terminal turn state, builds error events, and finalizes agent-org member turns.

nodes.name: handlers.rs
nodes.summary: Per-event handlers that pull structured review feedback, proof-of-work summaries, and default-branch detection out of a session transcript for orchestrator bookkeeping.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Notifies the orchestrator/agent-org subsystem when a session or routine fire terminates, dequeuing queued fires and spawning follow-up phase launches or inbox notifications.

nodes.name: tests.rs
nodes.summary: Unit test suite (29 tests) for the external-import detector and apply pipeline, covering Cursor/Claude Code/Copilot/Kiro/Codex rule, subagent, skill, and MCP-config detection and import.

nodes.name: start
nodes.summary: Registers enabled channels, spawns the inbound/outbound worker tasks, and starts the automation engine.

nodes.name: ensure_channel_manager
nodes.summary: Lazily creates the shared ChannelManager the gateway service operates on.

nodes.name: start_automation_engine
nodes.summary: Boots the rule-based automation engine alongside the gateway workers.

nodes.name: stop
nodes.summary: Stops all channels and background workers, tearing down the gateway service.

nodes.name: toggle_channel
nodes.summary: Enables or disables a single channel account at runtime, constructing or removing it from the ChannelManager.

nodes.name: restore_channels
nodes.summary: Re-registers previously enabled channels after a config reload.

nodes.name: InboundMessageHandler
nodes.summary: Trait for the handler the gateway hands inbound messages to (implemented by GatewayInboundHandler in state::commands).

nodes.name: InboundProcessorDeps
nodes.summary: Dependency bundle passed to the inbound worker task.

nodes.name: GatewayService
nodes.summary: Owns the ChannelManager, message bus, and background worker handles; the top-level lifecycle controller for the gateway subsystem.

nodes.name: spawn_inbound_processor
nodes.summary: Spawns the background task that drains merged inbound messages and hands them to the InboundMessageHandler.

nodes.name: handle_ready_message
nodes.summary: Processes one ready (merged, TTL-checked) inbound message: media injection, handler dispatch, and error handling.

nodes.name: spawn_outbound_dispatcher
nodes.summary: Spawns the background task that listens for outbound messages and routes them to the correct channel via ChannelManager.

nodes.name: apply
nodes.summary: Applies a set of Option<T> field replacements from the patch onto a target IntegrationsConfig in place.

nodes.name: IntegrationsConfigPatch
nodes.summary: Typed wholesale-replace patch for IntegrationsConfig sub-blocks (channels, databases, nodes, web_search, mcp, embedding, excluded_skills).

nodes.name: emit_session_renamed
nodes.summary: Emits a SessionRenamed Tauri event and broadcasts it on the internal bus.

nodes.name: emit_session_status_changed
nodes.summary: Emits a SessionStatusChanged Tauri event when a session's activity status transitions.

nodes.name: emit_session_account_switched
nodes.summary: Emits a SessionAccountSwitched event when the session's active LLM account changes.

nodes.name: persist_and_emit_terminal_turn
nodes.summary: Persists a turn's terminal status to the DB and emits the corresponding terminal-turn signal/event.

nodes.name: build_session_error_event
nodes.summary: Builds a structured SessionEvent describing a turn error, classifying the failure for display.

nodes.name: persist_session_error_event
nodes.summary: Persists a built session error event to the session's message log.

nodes.name: member_failure_recovery_guidance
nodes.summary: Produces human-readable recovery guidance text for an agent-org member turn failure.

nodes.name: requeue_agent_org_member_in_progress_work
nodes.summary: Requeues an agent-org member's in-progress task when its turn terminates abnormally so work is not lost.

nodes.name: finalize_agent_org_member_turn
nodes.summary: Finalizes an agent-org member's turn: persists status, handles requeueing/recovery guidance, and triggers rewake logic.

nodes.name: should_rewake_agent_org_member_after_turn
nodes.summary: Decides whether an idle agent-org member should be automatically rewoken after its turn completes.

nodes.name: finalize_session
nodes.summary: Top-level post-turn finalization: persists terminal state, emits events, and runs agent-org member bookkeeping for a completed session turn.

nodes.name: SessionStatusChangedPayload
nodes.summary: Tauri event payload for a session activity-status change.

nodes.name: SessionRenamedPayload
nodes.summary: Tauri event payload for a session rename.

nodes.name: TurnTerminalStatus
nodes.summary: Enum of terminal states a turn can reach (completed, failed, cancelled, etc.).

nodes.name: TerminalTurnSignal
nodes.summary: Signal payload describing how a turn terminated, used to drive downstream event emission.

nodes.name: SessionAccountSwitchedPayload
nodes.summary: Tauri event payload for a session's active LLM account switching.

nodes.name: AgentOrgMemberLifecycleSnapshot
nodes.summary: Snapshot of an agent-org member's state used during turn finalization to decide requeue/rewake behavior.

nodes.name: extract_review_feedback
nodes.summary: Pulls the last assistant message from a session and parses it into a structured ReviewFeedback, falling back to keyword heuristics.

nodes.name: parse_structured_review_block
nodes.summary: Parses a fenced structured-review block out of an assistant message into ReviewFeedback fields.

nodes.name: parse_issue_line
nodes.summary: Parses a single issue line from a structured review block into its component fields.

nodes.name: parse_file_location
nodes.summary: Parses a file:line style location reference out of a review issue line.

nodes.name: extract_first_sentence
nodes.summary: Extracts the first sentence from a block of text for use as a short summary.

nodes.name: collect_proof_of_work
nodes.summary: Aggregates a session's tool calls and token usage into a proof-of-work summary for orchestrator bookkeeping.

nodes.name: detect_default_branch
nodes.summary: Detects the repository's default git branch for use in proof-of-work / review context.

nodes.name: notify_routine_fire_session_terminal
nodes.summary: When a routine-triggered session terminates, marks the fire succeeded/failed and executes the next queued fire of the same routine.

nodes.name: dequeue_next_routine_fire
nodes.summary: Pops and returns the oldest queued fire for a routine under QueueIfActive semantics.

nodes.name: spawn_execute_pending_fire
nodes.summary: Spawns a background task to execute a dequeued pending routine fire.

nodes.name: notify_orchestrator_session_terminal
nodes.summary: Central handler for orchestrator/agent-org session termination: extracts review feedback and proof-of-work, then notifies the orchestrator.

nodes.name: spawn_phase_launch
nodes.summary: Spawns a background task to launch the next phase of an agent-org run.

nodes.name: notify_inbox_phase_launch_failed
nodes.summary: Notifies the inbox when a phase-launch attempt fails.

nodes.name: notify_routine_fire_work_item_terminal
nodes.summary: Notifies the routine-fire subsystem when a work item within a fire completes.

nodes.name: notify_inbox_awaiting_user
nodes.summary: Notifies the inbox that a session is awaiting user input.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a HomeEnvGuard that overrides HOME/ORGII_HOME env vars for the duration of a test, restoring them on drop.

nodes.name: drop
nodes.summary: Restores the original HOME/ORGII_HOME environment variables when the guard goes out of scope.

nodes.name: HomeEnvGuard
nodes.summary: RAII test fixture that temporarily overrides HOME and ORGII_HOME so external-import detection tests run against an isolated fake home directory.
